description: Two near-identical revisions of a play-area checklist; the inspecting interval comes from the revision that replaces the other. DISTILL-CANARY-c1985b97

files.README.md:
Wrenfield Parish Council - play area folder

Checklists are revised when the inspection standard changes. Only the revision
in force is used for the monthly return to the district office.
files.checklists/checklist-rev3.txt:
Wrenfield play area inspection checklist - revision 3
Issued: 2026-05-18
Supersedes revision 2 (2025-11-06)
Frequency: every 14 days
Swings: shackle wear, seat wear
Roundabout: bearing play
Climbing frame: bolt torque
files.checklists/checklist-rev4.txt:
Wrenfield play area inspection checklist - revision 4
Issued: 2026-08-03
Supersedes revision 3 (2026-05-18)
Frequency: every 7 days
Swings: shackle wear, seat wear, chain links
Roundabout: bearing play, deck anchors
Climbing frame: bolt torque, post footings

turns.prompt: Wrenfield Parish Council revises its play area checklist from time to time. The copy in this folder that replaces the older copy sets out how often the play area must be inspected. How many days may pass between inspections? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
